latestVersion.changelog:
- Added initial release of the "summarize" skill.
- Supports summarizing URLs, local files (PDFs, images, audio), and YouTube links using the summarize CLI.
- Default model is Google Gemini 3 Flash Preview; supports OpenAI, Anthropic, xAI, and custom configuration.
- Includes various output length options, machine-readable JSON flag, extraction-only mode, and fallback extraction services.
- Optional configuration via `~/.summarize/config.json` and support for external API keys for additional services.
